name: gmail-label-to-agent-email-draft

deploy.description: Gmail thread tagged with the nosey-reply label -> ask Dennis's personal Notion agent (Notion AI, via Notion Agents (Unofficial) 1.4.0) to write the reply -> wait for it -> save the reply as a Gmail draft in the thread, add Send to Notion, remove nosey-reply. Replaces the label-triggered Custom Agent.

trigger.authentication_note: Gmail dennis@work.flowers, the account-wide connection on 2.14.0 (also bound as gmail_wf for the draft and label writes).
trigger.trigger_note: Polling 'New Labeled Email': fires when the label is added, and ALSO on every later reply in a thread that still carries it. The workflow removes the label at the end so each tag is one request; on failure the label stays on as a marker. Deduped on message id, so re-tagging a thread with no new message since the last run does not fire again.

connections_note: notion_agents is the 'zapier-personal-agent' connection on the Notion Agents (Unofficial) custom integration (made on 1.1.0; the workflow calls App245513CLIAPI@1.4.0 explicitly). Not 'custom-agent-embed', which agent-chat-session-to-notion uses.
app_versions_note: Versions are pinned in the workflow's app ids (App245513CLIAPI@1.4.0, GoogleMailV2CLIAPI@2.14.0), not here.
